title: Total Distance Traveled
summary: A truck with two fuel tanks has a mileage of 10 km per liter.
statement: A truck with two fuel tanks has a mileage of 10 km per liter. When 5 liters are used from the main tank, 1 liter is transferred from the additional tank if it has at least 1 liter. Calculate the maximum distance the truck can travel.
constraints: The truck travels ten kilometers per liter consumed from its main tank.
After each five liters consumed from the main tank, transfer one liter from the additional tank when available.
Return the greatest total distance before the main tank becomes empty.
hints: A transfer adds one consumable liter after every five consumed liters.
With m original liters, the self-sustaining transfer opportunities are floor((m-1)/4), capped by additionalTank.
Add that transfer count to the original main-tank liters and multiply by ten.
Each transfer requires four more original-or-transferred liters beyond the previous trigger; the final empty state cannot trigger fuel that would be consumed afterward.
editorial: Each transfer requires four more original-or-transferred liters beyond the previous trigger; the final empty state cannot trigger fuel that would be consumed afterward.

tests.explanation: Five original liters trigger one transfer, so six liters are consumed for sixty kilometers.
The main tank empties before five liters are consumed, so no transfer occurs and distance is ten.
